buffer.title: Buffer
buffer.description: Schedule posts in Buffer and have an automation ready for each one.
buffer.howItWorks: Conversa only reads from Buffer and never changes your posts. Attach an automation to a post scheduled in Buffer; when Buffer publishes it, Conversa finds the post on Instagram and the automation starts answering its comments on its own.

readOnly.title: Only owners and admins can change this integration
readOnly.description: Ask an owner or an admin to connect or disconnect Buffer.

connect.hintEnd: and paste it here. It is stored encrypted.
connect.successDescription: Posts scheduled in Buffer now show on the Content page.

buffer.organizationHint: Conversa reads the posts and channels of this Buffer organization.
buffer.organizationPending: Choose the Buffer organization whose posts Conversa should read.
buffer.organizationSavedDescription: Conversa now reads the posts of {name}.

errors.unauthorized: Buffer stopped accepting the API key. Connect again with a new key.
errors.rate_limited: Buffer's request limit was reached. Conversa tries again on its own.
errors.not_found: A post or channel was no longer found in Buffer.
errors.unavailable: Buffer did not answer. Conversa tries again on its own.

disconnect.title: Disconnect Buffer?
disconnect.description: Conversa deletes the stored API key and stops reading Buffer. Automations already waiting on a Buffer post stay, but will not start until Buffer is connected again.

channels.title: Linked channels
channels.description: Buffer's Instagram channels and the Conversa channel with the same account.
channels.empty: This Buffer organization has no Instagram channels.
